title.zh: Wall Street regulator proposes rules on investment adviser crypto asset custody
title.en: Wall Street regulator proposes rules on investment adviser crypto asset custody

current_state.zh: The SEC proposed new rules governing how investment advisers must custody crypto assets, a step that would formalize compliance obligations for firms offering digital-asset exposure to clients.
